description: NaCaZrBiO₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic F̅43m space group. Na is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent CaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent BiO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.95 Å. Ca is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form CaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent CaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent BiO₆ octahedra. All Ca-O bond lengths are 2.95 Å. Zr is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent BiO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent CaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Zr-O bond lengths are 2.08 Å. Bi is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form BiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent CaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Bi-O bond lengths are 2.09 Å. O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Ca, one Zr, and one Bi atom.
